# Manoj Inamanamelluri

> Full-stack developer and UI/UX designer in Hyderabad, India. Builds web, mobile, and desktop applications with React, Flutter, and Node.js. Open to full-time roles and freelance work.

Manoj Inamanamelluri is based in Hyderabad, Telangana, India, and works with clients locally and remotely. Current role: Sr UI/UX Designer at Speshway Solutions (Jul 2026 – Present) — designs applications, develops Flutter mobile apps and MERN stack applications, and deploys mobile releases to the Play Store and the App Store. Previously UI/UX Designer & Developer at S&M Scholarly Solutions (Aug 2022 – Jul 2026). B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Vasireddy Venkatadri Institute of Technology (2017 – 2021). UI/UX Design Certification, Fullstack Academy (2022).

Services: web application development, mobile app development, desktop application development, UI/UX design, and graphic design.

Stack: Figma, React, Next.js, Flutter, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Electron.js, AWS, Azure, Git.

Email: manoj.inamanamelluri123@gmail.com
